scope: POC Ar- electronics via Gasteiger delta charge at ipso

computed_features.description: Number of detected Ar-* anchor sites in the molecule (from templated Ar-* atomic features).
Per-site electron-poor score (0..10) from Gasteiger delta charge (delta_q), mapped by round(5 + k*delta_q) and clamped.
Maximum electron-poor score (0..10) across Ar-* sites.
Per-site Gasteiger charge on the Ar ipso atom (q_ipso).
Per-site mean Gasteiger charge across the smallest aromatic ring containing ipso (q_ring_mean).
Per-site delta_q = q_ipso - q_ring_mean when ring is found, else delta_q = q_ipso.

notes: Anchor detection follows sterics workflow: compiled.atomic entries with source.kind='templated' and source.groups[0]='Ar', using atom-map ':1' to locate ipso in matches.
Ring mean uses the smallest aromatic ring containing ipso (all ring atoms aromatic).
Interpretation (POC): more positive delta_q => more electron-poor aryl.
Mapping: raw = 5 + k*delta_q; score = clamp(round(raw), 0, 10). Recommended starting k=25.
